scripts.bundle:head: rm -rf build/head && mkdir -p build/head && git -C ../.. archive HEAD lib/terminal | tar -x -C build/head && sed 's#../../../lib/terminal#./lib/terminal#' scripts/entry.ts > build/head/entry.ts && ../../node_modules/.bin/esbuild build/head/entry.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=node --outfile=build/engine.mjs --log-level=warning
scripts.export:web: npm run bundle && ../../node_modules/.bin/esbuild scripts/entry-router.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=node --outfile=build/router.mjs --log-level=warning && node scripts/export-web.mjs
